summary: Retested ProMão backend phase-two APIs and responsive UI. Core email auth, services, requests, provider catalog creation, public loading, search, and mobile landing layout work; phase-two authorization integration has blocking defects.

critical.issue: Responses project _id out but never add a serializable id. Pending photos therefore have no id, so the client UI sends an undefined id when authorizing; phase-two regression failed with KeyError('id').

Google exchange sets only a session_token cookie, while current_user reads access_token or Authorization and never reads session_token. A successful Google exchange cannot authenticate subsequent protected requests.
Public gateway OPTIONS response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, failing credentialed cross-origin preflight despite backend middleware configuration.

minor.issue: List projections exclude Mongo _id without replacing it with id; catalog/request list consumers cannot reliably identify records for later actions.

The required suggested credentials using @promao.local are rejected by EmailStr as a reserved domain (422); this is documented in test_credentials but still prevents those exact credentials from being used.

ui_bugs.issue: Two-column workspace remains wider than the 390px viewport; measured body scrollWidth was 392px and the right column is clipped.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete from real response because pending portfolio records omit id; authorize-photo action receives undefined record id.

Catalog POST succeeds and API persistence was confirmed directly, but the UI refresh assertion did not show the item during the automated session; recheck after fixing list identity and async loading state.

action_items: Make current_user accept the Google session_token cookie or set the cookie name/token consistently with the auth dependency.
Add id: str(_id) to all protected list responses before excluding _id, especially pending/public portfolio records.
Fix ingress/CDN OPTIONS CORS response to return the explicit preview origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
Add a mobile breakpoint for .workspace-grid so provider workspace columns stack at small widths.
Re-run provider catalog refresh and complete client authorization after the response-id fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Google OAuth is implemented as an exchange endpoint but is not wired into current_user, so the advertised real Google login is functionally broken after callback.
Mongo projections in phase-two list endpoints violate the frontend contract by removing _id without emitting id.
Portfolio image bytes are stored as MongoDB data URLs; this remains MOCKED storage as specified. Provider fallback cards are also MOCKED demo data when no providers exist.

success_rate.backend: 6/7 baseline passed; phase-two workflow failed at pending portfolio identity
success_rate.frontend: Core loading/navigation/search/mobile landing passed; provider mobile overflow and phase-two authorization unresolved

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ provider/client accounts, one catalog item, request, offer, and pending portfolio photo through public APIs/UI; no seeded records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recheck Google callback session authentication, portfolio pending/public ids and authorization, provider catalog refresh, and 390px workspace overflow. Baseline auth/request tests are in test_promao_api.py; phase-two regression intentionally fails on missing portfolio id.
rca of the issue: Phase-two endpoints use Mongo projections with _id:0 and return raw documents, so records lack the id expected by React actions. Google exchange stores a different cookie name (session_token) than current_user checks (access_token), making the exchanged session unusable. Provider CSS defines a permanent two-column grid and only adds mobile overrides for profile-columns, not workspace-grid.
